rationale: The short thesis relied on price holding below the 5m 9-EMA, but price has reclaimed the 9-EMA (27.26) and is printing flat-to-higher 1m candles, indicating stalled downside momentum. With no news and a risk-on market, the edge for a continued drop has diminished, so closing to avoid a potential bounce to the 27.45 invalidation is prudent.
